name: sgs/process-steps
title: SGS Process Steps
description: Horizontal timeline showing a multi-step process.

wrapper.label: Wrapper
wrapper._note: No `layer` declared (leaf content block, no grid/flex attrs). `effectHover` is a preset picker choosing WHICH hover treatment applies (Spec 35 FR-35-5 false-friend — contains 'Hover' but is not itself a state-variant style property, so it is NOT mapped into `states.hover` and stays an honest orphan/behaviour toggle). The wrapper declares no native `supports.typography`; typography is owned per element (icon, number, title, description) through the shared TypographyControls/sgs_typography_css_rule() families. backgroundColourGradient/textColourGradient added (QC-council-validated) — keyed `css:background-color-gradient`/`css:color-gradient` distinct from each other, since this wrapper paints BOTH background and text on the same root selector (info-box's `box` element precedent). render.php moves the background paint onto a `::after` layer (`sgs_block_background_layer_css()`) so it cannot be clipped by a text gradient's `background-clip:text` on the same node.

icon.label: Step icon
icon._note: The optional Lucide icon above each step's number. Its size is a font-size (the SVG is 1em square), so the icon typography family sizes the glyph and aligns it. Typography emits through sgs_typography_css_rule() as a descendant of the block root, so it out-ranks style.css's `:where()` defaults. The icon colour is not an attribute on this block: style.css paints it from the primary token.

title.label: Step title
title._note: Typography migrated off WP-native supports.typography onto the shared TypographyControls/sgs_typography_css_rule() mechanism (D971/D972), prefix 'title' (titleFontSize/titleFontWeight/titleFontStyle/titleLineHeight) — replaces the old native:typography.* attrMap entries and the block-level `selectors.typography` declaration (both removed). No letterSpacing/textTransform/textAlign control is offered, so those remain honest gaps (previously native-typography-only). titleColour is a separate design-token colour attr (resolves via default convention `title`+`Colour`). `attrMap.tag` (D-pending, E12 scoping fix) — `headingLevel` sets the rendered tag on this element (render.php, `.sgs-process-steps__title`) but doesn't match the `title` prefix convention on its own.

number.label: Step number badge
number._note: numberStyle (circle/square/none variant) is a structural/variant selector, not a style-cluster member — not mapped. Both colour members resolve via default convention (`number`+`Colour`/`Background`). numberColourHoverGradient mirrors the wrapper element's textColourHoverGradient sibling pattern — hover text colour or gradient, ancestor-hover shape (`.step:hover .number{color}`), lifted from sgs/post-grid's textColourHover precedent (see the block's own CLAUDE.md known-precedent registry). When the `layout` attribute (also a structural/variant selector, not mapped) is 'list', render.php suppresses numberBackground/numberBackgroundGradient/numberBackgroundHover — the number keeps numberColour but paints no badge fill, matching the plain-numbered-copy layout. Typography is the full shared TypographyControls/sgs_typography_css_rule() family under prefix 'number'; only set properties are emitted, and unset, style.css's own `:where()` size, weight and line-height defaults stay.

description.label: Step description
description._note: Colour and the full typography family (prefix 'description') are independently controlled. Typography emits through sgs_typography_css_rule() as a descendant of the block root, so it out-ranks style.css's `:where()` defaults; unset, those defaults paint.

connector.label: Connector line
connector._note: connectorStyle (line/none) is a structural variant selector — no colour/fill control exists for the connector on this block (unlike sgs/timeline's connectorColour). Declared for documentation only; orphan-scan-exempt (no prefix). The connector never renders when `layout` is 'list' (style.css hides the step's ::after regardless of connectorStyle), since a stacked list of plain numbered copy has no line to connect.

animation.label: Scroll-reveal animation
animation._note: Spec 35 FR-35-6 — JS scroll-driven motion, a separate mechanism from the `motion` (CSS-transition) cluster on `wrapper`. No stagger/parallax/trigger attrs exist on this block — honest gaps.

step.label: Process step
step._note: Per-step fields (number/title/description/icon) are plain repeater content from the `steps` array — styled block-wide via the icon/number/title/description elements above, no independent per-step override. Mirrors sgs/accordion's `item` and sgs/timeline's `entry`.

layout.description: Overall step arrangement. 'row' (default) draws the existing horizontal badge-and-connector timeline. 'list' stacks steps vertically with a plain number to the left of the title/description, no circle badge and no connector line — for plain numbered copy such as 'how it works'. Existing pages are unaffected (default keeps today's output).

backgroundColour.description: RESTING wrapper background colour — block-private (native supports.color.background is disabled).

backgroundColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the RESTING wrapper background instead of the flat backgroundColour. Non-empty wins over backgroundColour at render time (mirrors the borderColourGradient/numberBackgroundGradient pattern).

textColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the RESTING wrapper text colour instead of the flat textColour. Non-empty wins over textColour at render time (background-clip:text).

backgroundColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the HOVER wrapper background instead of the flat backgroundColourHover. Non-empty wins over backgroundColourHover at render time.

textColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the HOVER wrapper text colour instead of the flat textColourHover. Non-empty wins over textColourHover at render time (background-clip:text).

borderColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the wrapper's hover-state border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColourHover on :hover.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the wrapper's resting border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.

stepGap.description: Space between the steps (a CSS length). Empty keeps the stylesheet's spacing-30 gap.

numberGap.description: List layout only: space between the step number and its text (a CSS length). Empty keeps the stylesheet's spacing-20 gap.
